Earth texture maps sourced from the official Three.js planet examples:
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/dev/examples/textures/planets

Original filenames: earth_atmos_2048.jpg, earth_normal_2048.jpg,
earth_specular_2048.jpg, earth_clouds_1024.png.
Bundled locally so the visualization does not depend on a remote texture host.

Moon surface: moon_1024.jpg from the same Three.js planet examples.

Follow-mode surface: earth-day-8k.jpg is an 8192x4096 downsample of NASA
Blue Marble Next Generation, January 2004, with topographic shading.
Source: https://assets.science.nasa.gov/content/dam/science/esd/eo/images/bmng/bmng-topography/january/world.topo.200401.3x21600x10800.jpg
Credit: NASA Earth Observatory, Blue Marble Next Generation.
This modern composite is a visualization texture, not historical 1973 imagery.
